thread:
sara: Postmortem follow-up for the Dedicated tenant outage last night. Root cause: VPC peering mismatch + edge NAT rewriting. Postmortem link: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/dedicated-2025-06-tenant|dedicated-2025-06-tenant>.
ops-bot: postmortem published by @sara.
dave: thanks. What are the remaining action items?
sara: Open list:
- ACT-901: Fix peering policy to preserve source-IP (owner: @dave)
- ACT-902: Customer KB for on-prem NAT rules (owner: @lisa)
- ACT-903: Add route-flap detection & alerting (owner: @ying)
lisa: Clarifying Q: customer had two NAT rules; which one rewrote the peer subnet? Need exact example to show in KB.
dave: it was the outbound masquerade rule tied to the edge firewall. When peered, return traffic got SNAT'd and returned via a different path. Triggered KV replication timeouts.
ying: short mitigation we can deploy: add a probe that checks return-path symmetry and fail fast on asymmetry, also a short cooldown circuit-breaker. I can add an alert: "peering-return-path-mismatch" -> page eng-sre.
dave: I can push the peering policy change to preserve src-ip and add a rollback plan. Target date: 2025-06-15 for canary, 2025-06-22 for full rollout.
lisa: I'll draft the KB with examples and CLI/snippets by 2025-06-09 and share here. Will include commands to inspect BGP neighbors and NAT rule examples.
sara: couple of follow-ups: 1) add quarterly peering audits for all Dedicated customers (owner: sara), and 2) add a regression test in the onprem CI that simulates asymmetric return paths (owner: ying).
ying: noted, will add the test to the CI board and estimate work next sprint.
sara: I'll update the postmortem with owners + dates and link the Jira epic INF-9002. Weekly check-ins Tuesdays; I'll ping this thread with progress.
dave: ack, starting the peering PR today.
lisa: ack, will post KB draft by Monday.
sara: closing for now  reopen if blockers come up.
